description.value: Play is Kelowna's premium athletic footwear and apparel specialty store, focused on running, training, hiking, and lifestyle products from top brands including Salomon, HOKA, On, Brooks, Patagonia, and Arc'teryx. Located at Harvey Avenue and Spall Road, the shop stocks a wide range of performance gear including nutrition products (Tailwind, Skratch Labs, Maurten), hydration vests, and accessories relevant to endurance athletes. They also host a Play Run Club, making them a community hub for active locals and visiting athletes.
